name: IS_Bench_dataset
description:
Dataset Card for IS-Bench
	

This dataset is for paper IS-Bench: Evaluating Interactive Safety of VLM-Driven Embodied Agents in Daily Household Tasks
⭐ You can check our Paper, Github, Project Page for more information.

	
		
		Usage
	


Online Evaluation: Download scenes.tar.gz and load these scene files in Omnigibson simulator.

Offline Evaluation: Download scene_images.tar.gz and use the scene images in it as input directly.


Please see IS-Bench code for more details.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ursulalala/IS_Bench_dataset.
reputation: A recent research benchmark targeting a niche community studying safety of VLM-driven embodied agents; growing interest but limited adoption so far.
